posts.en:
dsh-bull-bear is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b4be6c33275836babae2.html
